$comment: Topic manifest (spec §12). Single source for platform/kafka-init and for producer/consumer tests. No .retry.* topics: transient failures are retried inside the consumer (3 attempts), then the event goes to <topic>.dlq. Key = school_id everywhere.

topics.name: solve.status
topics.$comment: solve.started and solve.completed share this topic so that the partition keeps their order per job.

dlq.$comment: One DLQ per consumed topic. Written by the consumer of that topic after its in-consumer retries (or at once for deterministic/unparseable input). Diagnostics only: solve.* events are never replayed from the DLQ (the job watchdog has already closed the job).
